iconicAnchor.label: The Daily Astorian newspaper archive
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Library of Congress newspaper record and digitized issues provide primary examples of masthead authority, multi-column density, headline hierarchy, date and price lines, captioned images, and modular front-page assembly.

sources.title: The Daily Astorian
supports: Digitized newspaper issues show dense columns, multiple story decks, recurring masthead furniture, and period-specific front-page structure.
The item record grounds the style in a real serial publication rather than a generic collage of clippings.

sources.title: Chronicling America: Historic American Newspapers
supports: The collection supplies broad primary evidence for changing newspaper page organization, typography, and image reproduction.
Its historical scope helps separate broadsheet grammar from one title's ornamental identity.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches masthead, multi deck headline, dense columns, captioned photo, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/news-broadsheet/reference-02.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
